theater: 阿姆布拉基亞灣口的阿克興海峽

battle.name: 亞克興戰爭
battle.theater: 阿姆布拉基亞灣口的阿克興海峽
battle.brief: 西元前31年9月2日，屋大維的艦隊在阿克興海峽擊敗安東尼與克婁巴特拉七世的聯軍，內戰走向自此定型。安東尼以高身戰船排成新月陣，卻被阿格里帕的輕艇插入中軍而崩解。卡面的羅馬弩砲是阿格里帕架在甲板上的扭力砲之一，用以壓制敵船；海戰之後，它又隨攻城器械進逼安東尼的海灘營壘。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 西元前31年的阿克興戰爭是羅馬內戰的最後一場決戰，交戰雙方是屋大維一方與安東尼、克婁巴特拉七世一方。屋大維一方以義大利本土的軍團為骨幹，背後是元老院、義大利商人與退伍老兵的共同支持；海軍由馬庫斯·維普薩尼奧斯·阿格里帕實際統率，艦隊分為三支縱隊，另拉攏馬其頓的塞琉古與伊利里亞的船隻作側翼，陸軍則由屋大維本人帶領，在阿克興以西的營地待命。安東尼一方是聯軍的形狀：安東尼自任總指揮，下令把海軍排成橫跨海峽的新月形，艦隊分三段，右翼交給卡諾普斯（埃涅烏斯），左翼交給卡尼迪烏斯，中軍是安東尼的旗艦與克婁巴特拉的十二艘埃及戰船；岸上留有十一個軍團與約八千騎兵，由卡尼迪烏斯統率。埃及以麥糧、駿馬、金錢與二百艘運輸船支援安東尼，希臘東部的城市和塞琉古、帕提亞也以不公開的方式站在安東尼一邊。於是這不是義大利同盟對上一個城邦，而是海上兩套體系——以羅馬為骨幹的義大利聯盟海軍，對上托勒密王朝的海上力量與安東尼十年東方經營的成果。
countriesEn: The Battle of Actium in 31 BC was the last decisive engagement of the Roman civil wars, fought between the side of Octavian and the side of Antony together with Cleopatra VII. Octavian's side was built on the legions of the Italian peninsula and backed by the Senate, the Italian commercial classes and the veterans; the navy was in fact commanded by Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa and organised in three squadrons, with Macedonian and Illyrian vessels used for the flanking work, while Octavian himself led the army encamped to the west of Actium. Antony's side had the shape of a coalition: Antony took overall command and had his fleet drawn up in a crescent spanning the strait, divided into three parts, the right wing under Canopus (Eneius), the left wing under Canidius, and in the centre Antony's flagship together with the twelve Egyptian ships of Cleopatra; on shore he left eleven legions and about eight thousand horsemen under Canidius. Egypt supported Antony with grain, horses, money and some two hundred transport vessels; the cities of eastern Greece, together with Seleucid and Parthian interests, leaned towards Antony without open commitment. So this was not an Italian alliance facing a single city-state, but two systems at sea: the navy of the Italian alliance built around Rome, set against the naval power of the Ptolemaic kingdom and the results of a decade of Antony's eastern conquests.
people: 關鍵人物集中在屋大維與安東尼兩端，中間由海軍的實際指揮者串起。屋大維時年二十八歲，這一戰他刻意不把自己放在最顯眼的旗艦上，而是乘小艇在戰列之間穿梭，把海戰的指揮交給阿格里帕，自己坐鎮右翼百二十艘大船的縱隊，戰前夜通宵未眠，屢次派人到各縱隊傳令。真正決定打法的是阿格里帕：他以左翼六十艘大船配合大量利布奈輕艇，把左翼拉直，逼安東尼維持新月形的同時讓中軍突出，再用輕艇插入中央空隙，反擊安東尼旗艦與周邊船群的尾部。安東尼方面的關鍵人物是卡諾普斯與卡尼迪烏斯：前者率右翼的十一個軍團戰船，卻被自家久戰疲憊的士兵牽制，攻勢始終推不上去；後者在岸上掌握營壘，卻無力回援海上的中軍。安東尼本人發出的反擊命令傳達遲滯，錯過了可以扭轉的時間窗。安東尼的舵手阿納克塞諾（埃皮魯斯人）力勸他脫離重圍，這個建議最終被採納，克婁巴特拉率十二艘船先行出逃，安東尼隨之退出戰場。另有西克斯圖斯·龐培以共和遺臣的身分站在屋大維這邊，指揮一支分遣隊。戰後屋大維留下的《阿克興戰記》殘篇，是當事人留下的第一手記錄，也讓這場海戰的部署細節得以流傳。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities stand at the two ends of the conflict, with the effective naval commander linking them. Octavian was twenty-eight years old, and in this battle he deliberately kept himself off the most conspicuous flagship, moving between the lines in a small boat and leaving the conduct of the sea fight to Agrippa while sitting in the right wing of one hundred and twenty heavy ships; he went without sleep the night before the action and sent messengers repeatedly to the squadrons. The man who actually decided the method was Agrippa: with sixty heavy ships on his left wing backed by a great number of liburnian galleys, he straightened that wing, obliging Antony to hold the crescent while his centre bulged forward, and then drove his light craft through the gap to strike the rear of Antony's flagship and the ships around it. On Antony's side the key figures were Canopus and Canidius: the former commanded the right wing, whose war-weary legionaries held the line back and the advance could never be pressed, while the latter held the shore camp but could not bring it to the aid of the fleet in the centre. The counter-attack ordered by Antony himself was transmitted late, and the window in which it might have turned the battle was lost. Anaxenor of Epirus, his helmsman, urged him to break out of the encirclement; the advice was finally taken up, and Cleopatra ran out with twelve ships, Antony following her out of the battle. Sextus Pompeius, the last Republican admiral, stood with Octavian and led a detached squadron. The fragmentary Actian diary left behind by Octavian is the first-hand record that survives from the principals themselves, and it is the source through which the details of the deployment have come down to us.
kits: 卡面的羅馬弩砲在這一戰裡出現了兩個位置。第一個在海上：阿格里帕的旗艦甲板上架著三挺重型扭力砲，這是希臘式扭力機械第一次被成規模地裝上軍艦。弩砲用扭力束拉緊弓臂，一次只發一具箭，射程數百步，射速慢、裝填繁複，但甲板上居高臨下，可以掃射敵船的划槳手與登船反制兵，也能擊穿甲板、打壞舵位。屋大維一方在甲板與前部船樓都設了這種火力，作用是把安東尼高身戰船上的射擊位壓住，讓己方的登船兵有地方落腳。第二個位置在岸上：安東尼的營壘退到海峽內側的灘地，屋大維海軍得勝之後，隨軍攻城器械——扭力弩砲、投石機、攻城塔——被卸下運上岸，逐日進逼塹壕與木柵；安東尼的海灘防線最終不是被正面攻破，而是被包圍、斷糧與逃亡瓦解。艦隊本身是另一套裝備：安東尼的高身九列戰船裝有撞角與登船橋，舷上疊起木塔以居高臨下射擊；埃及船隻體格相近但吃水較深，機動遲緩，轉向笨重。屋大維一方的主力是數量龐大的利布奈輕艇，撞角是羊頭形，兩舷裝投石索，艇上載重裝步兵，船身低、吃水淺，能在安東尼的高船之間穿梭。雙方都備了火船：安東尼兩度企圖用裝載易燃物料的駁船順風突入羅馬縱隊，第一次被利布奈艇擋開，第二次一度衝散中軍，卻因羅馬船上備有沙袋與水櫃而熄火。羅馬海軍陸戰隊用大圓盾成排作戰，登船後轉入白刃格鬥。
kitsEn: The Roman bolt-shooting torsion catapult on this card occupies two positions in the battle. The first is at sea: three heavy torsion engines stood on the deck of Agrippa's flagship, the first large-scale mounting of Greek torsion machinery on warships. Each engine used twisted skeins to bend its arms, fired a single bolt, reached several hundred paces, and had a slow rate of fire and a complicated reload, but from the height of a deck it could sweep the enemy's oarsmen and boarding troops, punch through decking and damage the steering. Octavian's side mounted this kind of firepower on the decks and forward superstructures, with the object of silencing the shooting positions of Antony's tall ships so that the boarding parties would have somewhere to land. The second position is ashore: Antony's camp had fallen back to the beach inside the strait, and after the sea fight Octavian's siege train — bolt-throwing catapults, stone-throwers and siege towers — was landed and advanced day by day against the ditch and the palisade; Antony's beach line was not broken by a frontal assault but unravelled through encirclement, cut supply and desertion. The fleets themselves form a different world of equipment. Antony's tall quinqueremes carried rams and boarding bridges, with timber turrets stacked high to shoot downward; the Egyptian ships were comparable in size but deeper in the draught, slow to manoeuvre and clumsy to turn. The main strength on Octavian's side was a great number of liburnian galleys, with a ram's-head at the prow, slings along the flanks and heavy infantry carried on board, low in the hull and shallow in the draught, able to slip between Antony's towering hulls. Both sides also prepared fire ships: twice Antony tried to drive burning barges downwind into the Roman squadrons, the first attempt blocked by the liburnians, the second briefly scattering the centre, only to be smothered by the sandbags and water casks carried on the Roman decks. Roman marines fought in line with the large round shield and turned to hand-to-hand fighting after leaping across to the enemy's decks.
tactics: 海戰的部署本身就是戰術。安東尼選了一個橫跨阿克興海峽的新月陣：兩翼分別倚在海角與對岸，突出的一端藏進海峽最窄處，中軍最深地伸進海灣，企圖用地形逼屋大維只能用同樣狹窄的正面來攻，再靠高身戰船的撞角與登船力硬吃對方。屋大維沒有照對方的劇本走。開戰前阿格里帕把自己的左翼向前拉直，強迫安東尼維持新月形的同時把中軍往前凸出；屋大維隨即把相鄰的縱隊向中軍收攏，兩翼壓住安東尼的兩翼，中路反而放行，讓中軍被孤立在自己的大隊之外。接著利布奈輕艇從缺口穿過，攻擊安東尼旗艦與周邊船群的背面，海上的優勢就這樣在幾刻鐘內翻轉。約在中午後缺口撕開的同時，安東尼右翼的軍團戰船失去進取，己方的士兵不願再戰，埃及分遣隊亦先行掉頭。安東尼全軍的崩潰不是被正面擊穿的，而是三件事同時打倒它：右翼的軍團不肯再進、中軍被輕艇包圍、午後起風的海面讓逃跑的船隻無法張帆。追擊的利布奈艇封死了海峽出口。接下來是圍城式的收尾：安東尼退回岸上營壘，屋大維沒有急著強攻，而是以外線包住營地、切斷從阿克興通向內陸的道路、封住水井，逼十一個軍團在缺糧缺水的狀況下作出選擇。糧食原本靠埃及船隊運來，埃及船隊卻已隨克婁巴特拉離去，營地的補給線在幾天之內自行斷裂。
tacticsEn: The deployment was itself the tactic. Antony chose a crescent stretching across the strait of Actium: the wings rested on the cape and the opposite shore, the forward point was tucked into the narrowest part of the channel, and the centre was pushed deepest into the gulf, in the hope that the terrain would force Octavian to attack on an equally narrow front and let his tall ships do the work with ram and boarding. Octavian refused to follow that script. Before contact Agrippa pushed his left wing forward in a straight line, which obliged Antony to hold the crescent while his centre bulged out; Octavian then closed the neighbouring squadrons towards the centre, pressed both wings against Antony's flanks and left the middle open, so that the centre was isolated from the rest of the line. The liburnians then passed through the gap and struck the rear of Antony's flagship and the ships around it, and the balance of the sea turned within a few minutes. Around the middle of the day, as the gap opened, the war-weary legions in Antony's right wing ceased to advance and their crews would not press on, and the Egyptian detachment turned away before it was engaged. Antony's line did not break because it was beaten head-on, but because three things happened at once: the right-wing legions would not go forward, the centre was enveloped by the light galleys, and the wind that rose in the afternoon prevented the fugitives from using their sails. The pursuing liburnians sealed the mouth of the strait. What followed was a closing of the noose rather than an assault: after Antony withdrew into his camp, Octavian did not attack at once, but ringed the camp, cut the road inland from Actium and sealed the wells, forcing eleven legions to choose with food and water running short. The grain had come by sea with the Egyptian fleet, and the Egyptian fleet had gone with Cleopatra, so the supply line of the camp broke on its own within a few days.
data: 可核的數字大致如下。日期：西元前31年9月2日，海戰自上午約九時打到下午四時；同年七月與八月，安東尼兩度以火船襲擊羅馬縱隊，均未成功。艦隊：安東尼一方約五百艘戰船，另有約二百艘運輸船；屋大維一方約二百六十艘大船，此外有大量利布奈輕艇。普魯塔克記屋大維把艦隊分三段，左翼六十艘由阿格里帕指揮，中軍六十艘由盧庫路斯指揮，右翼百二十艘由屋大維自領。陸軍：安東尼在海灘營壘留有十一個軍團與約八千騎兵；普魯塔克記屋大維投入步兵約八萬、騎兵約一萬二千，安東尼在東方的總兵力約十三萬步兵、一萬二千騎兵。損失：接戰期間安東尼實際損失的戰船數目不多，普魯塔克記為三艘，但十二艘埃及船隨克婁巴特拉逃回埃及；雙方陣亡各約一萬二千人，屋大維陣中另有三千人死於疫病，安東尼方面被俘約三萬人。戰後：安東尼營壘的十一個軍團與約八千騎兵在九月下旬不戰而降，屋大維自營中挑出菁英編入自己的軍隊，其餘遣散回鄉。戰役從西元前32年開打到前31年，全程約兩年，決定性的一日只有一日。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are roughly as follows. Date: 2 September 31 BC, the sea fight running from about the ninth hour of the morning to the fourth hour of the afternoon; in the same year, in July and again in August, Antony twice attempted to launch fire ships against the Roman squadrons, without success. Fleets: Antony had about five hundred warships and some two hundred transports; Octavian had about two hundred and sixty heavy ships and in addition a great number of liburnian galleys. Plutarch records that Octavian divided his fleet into three squadrons, sixty ships in the left wing under Agrippa, sixty in the centre under Lucullus, and one hundred and twenty in the right wing under Octavian himself. Land forces: Antony's camp on the beach held eleven legions and about eight thousand horsemen; Plutarch gives Octavian about eighty thousand infantry and twelve thousand cavalry, against Antony's overall strength in the east of roughly one hundred and thirty thousand foot and twelve thousand horse. Losses: relatively few Antonian ships were actually destroyed in the fighting, Plutarch counting three, but the twelve Egyptian ships escaped with Cleopatra to Egypt; about twelve thousand men were killed on each side, three thousand more in Octavian's camp died of disease, and roughly thirty thousand of Antony's men were taken prisoner. Aftermath: the eleven legions and some eight thousand horsemen in Antony's camp surrendered without a fight in the last days of September, Octavian taking the pick of them into his own army and dismissing the rest to their homes. The campaign ran from 32 to 31 BC, about two years in all, of which the decisive day lasted a single day.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。第一層是同盟本身崩解：屋大維、安東尼與雷必達三人於西元前43年組成的三頭同盟，在雷必達於前36年戰死後只剩下兩人，前40年的桑斯圖斯會議與前42年的布匿斯會議把行省瓜分完，兩人之後只剩互相防範。第二層是安東尼在東方的成功：前36年他打贏了沙拉帕克斯戰役，把亞美尼亞與中亞的一小部分拉進羅馬的勢力範圍，此後連續東征，到前32年已自稱要為全人類向亞細亞人開戰；這份軍功在意大利換來的是年輕一輩的反感、商人被徵收款項的怨懟，以及元老院對他越權的恐懼。第三層是克婁巴特拉的介入：前36年安東尼在安提阿會見托勒密王朝的君主克婁巴特拉七世，前32年又公開迎娶她，把東方數省當作私產分配，並在遺囑中安排子嗣繼承；屋大維隨即在元老院宣布該遺囑無效。第四層是克婁巴特拉自己的處境：托勒密王朝的疆土已被安東尼的羅馬公民任意居住與徵用，埃及的港口與穀倉全在安東尼控制之下，若屋大維勝利，埃及連自保的餘地都沒有，於是傾國之力押上。屋大維於前32年7月宣布安東尼為公敵，前31年春天兩軍在希臘相接，最後的會戰地點就選在安東尼營壘前方的海峽。
causeEn: Four layers of cause lie behind the fighting. The first is the collapse of the triumvirate itself: the alliance of Octavian, Antony and Lepidus formed in 43 BC was reduced to two men when Lepidus died in 36 BC, and the division of the provinces at the conferences of Sinussa in 40 BC and Brundisium in 42 BC left the two survivors with nothing left to divide and everything left to fear. The second is Antony's success in the east: in 36 BC he won the battle of Satala and pulled part of Armenia and Central Asia into the Roman sphere, and his campaigns of the years after left him, by 32 BC, claiming to wage war on the Asians on behalf of all mankind. That military glory bought him in Italy the hostility of the younger generation, the resentment of merchants who were called on to hand over money, and the fear of a Senate that distrusted his constitutional pretensions. The third is the intervention of Cleopatra: Antony met the Ptolemaic monarch Cleopatra VII at Antioch in 36 BC, and in 32 BC he married her publicly, distributed the eastern provinces as private property and set out his children's succession in his will; Octavian had the will declared invalid in the Senate. The fourth is Cleopatra's own position: the territory of the Ptolemaic kingdom had already been opened to Roman citizens and requisitioned at will by Antony, the harbours and granaries of Egypt were in Antony's hands, and if Octavian won, Egypt would have no room left even to defend itself, so it staked everything on the war. Octavian declared Antony an outlaw in July 32 BC; the two armies met in Greece in the spring of 31 BC, and the place of the last engagement was the strait in front of Antony's camp.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是地中海東部的政治版圖整個重畫。安東尼的勢力解體，希臘與小亞細亞重新歸入羅馬的秩序，屋大維在戰後數月內把東方行省分給元老院與自己，前29年元老院授他「奧古斯都」之號，共和國的形式保留到形式終於無力維持，帝制由此定形。埃及在次年成為羅馬行省，亞歷山大被占，羅馬的穀倉從此每年有埃及小麥運入，屋大維解決了共和時期長期困擾羅馬的糧食供應問題。戰場本身被國家化：屋大維在阿克興海角建起阿波羅神廟，把掠得的戰利品奉獻其上，並在附近建立新城尼科波利斯，前29年起以阿克興之名每四年舉辦競技會，這座新城在往後數個世紀是希臘世界最重要的標誌性都市之一，亞克興戰役的浮雕後來被刻上和平祭壇的外壁。希臘各城的財物在此戰後被系統性地搜刮，繪畫、雕塑與青銅像大批運回羅馬，希臘藝術品成為羅馬貴族身份的新來源。對地中海的權力結構而言，亞克興之後再沒有任何一支海軍能正面挑戰羅馬，羅馬的海上霸權在此定型，東地中海的行省管理也自此展開。
impactEn: The direct consequence of this war was a wholesale redrawing of the political map of the eastern Mediterranean. Antony's power fell apart, Greece and Asia Minor returned to the Roman order, and within months of the battle Octavian distributed the eastern provinces between the Senate and himself; in 29 BC the Senate granted him the title of Augustus, and the forms of the Republic survived only until they could no longer be maintained, with the principate taking shape. Egypt became a Roman province the following year, Alexandria was occupied, and Roman granaries began drawing Egyptian wheat every year, solving for Octavian the long-standing grain supply problem of the Republic. The battlefield itself was made into a monument of state: Octavian raised a temple of Apollo on the cape of Actium, dedicated the spoils to it, and founded the new city of Nicopolis nearby, where games in honour of Actium were held every four years from 29 BC. That city became, in the centuries that followed, one of the most important symbolic urban foundations of the Greek world, and a relief of the battle of Actium was later carved onto the outer face of the Ara Pacis. The property of the Greek cities was systematically stripped after the war: paintings, statues and bronzes were carried off to Rome in bulk, and Greek works of art became a new badge of identity for the Roman aristocracy. In terms of the power structure of the Mediterranean, after Actium no fleet could again challenge Rome directly, Roman seapower was fixed, and the administrative system of the eastern provinces began to unfold.
result: 阿克興海峽內的決定性一場，結果是安東尼的艦隊在幾個小時內失去戰鬥力。中軍被利布奈輕艇從背面撕開，安東尼的旗艦陷入包圍，右翼的軍團戰船停止進取，埃及分遣隊不戰而退，克婁巴特拉帶著十二艘船先走，安東尼隨之退向埃及。追擊的利布奈艇封住海峽出口，殘餘的安東尼戰船不是被燒就是被奪，兩岸的海灣變成卸載戰利品的場所。安東尼退入營壘後，海上的一方已經不在場：屋大維的陸軍包圍營地、切斷補給，十一個軍團與約八千騎兵在九月下旬不戰而降，屋大維把其中菁英編入自己的隊伍，其餘遣散回鄉。營壘與阿克興要塞隨後在攻城器械下陷落。到西元前30年，屋大維進軍埃及，亞歷山大在沒有決定性會戰的情況下陷落，安東尼與克婁巴特拉先後自盡，托勒密王朝終結，埃及成為羅馬的永久領土。自此之後，羅馬內戰不再有新的大規模對手，屋大維成為地中海唯一的主宰者，亞克興也從此成為「決定性戰役」這個詞在西方政治文化中的原型。
resultEn: In the strait of Actium the decisive action ended with Antony's fleet losing its fighting power within a few hours. The centre was torn open from the rear by the liburnians, Antony's flagship was enveloped, the legionary ships on the right wing ceased to press forward, the Egyptian detachment turned away without a blow, and Cleopatra left with twelve ships, Antony following towards Egypt. The pursuing liburnians sealed the outlet of the strait, and the surviving Antonian ships were either burned or taken, the bay becoming a place where the spoil was unloaded. After Antony retired into his camp the sea power was no longer there: Octavian's army ringed the camp and cut its supply, and the eleven legions with about eight thousand horsemen surrendered without a fight in the last days of September, Octavian enrolling the best of them in his own ranks and dismissing the rest to their homes. The camp and the fortifications of Actium then fell to the siege train. In 30 BC Octavian marched into Egypt, Alexandria fell without a set-piece battle, Antony and Cleopatra took their own lives in turn, the Ptolemaic dynasty ended and Egypt became a permanent Roman possession. After this no large-scale opponent remained to the Roman Republic, Octavian became the sole undisputed master of the Mediterranean, and Actium has been the model of the decisive battle in Western political culture ever since.
